items.title: Show HN: Vibecheck – merge gate that checks you understand your AI-written code
items.snippet: Good evening folks, I built Github merge gate which that checks whether developers understand their own code when they create a PR. I kept getting sent PRs to review where it was obvious the author had pasted the ticket into an LLM and called it a day. It's self-hosted (so you can use it in your enterprise environments or privately) It is BYOK (Anthropic) obviously. I have two demos in the pull requests here: https://github.com/bhurghundii/vibecheck.dev/pulls - you can see what Vibecheck does (it blocks a PR for clearly showing no attempt vs a PR which gets it right) I would love feedback, especially from anyone dealing with a similar problem. I do use it for my own projects a lot so expect improvements.

items.title: Show HN: LogLineAlign: Merge logs from different time zones into one timeline
items.snippet: https://loglinealign.com/ I vibe-coded an application that merges entries from multiple log files into a single, chronologically ordered view. It handles timezone offsets and can auto-detect some timestamp formats, with an option to specify the format manually. Files are processed on your device and not uploaded to a server. It's all open source: https://github.com/jftuga/loglinealign In the repo, there is a quick, 3 minute narrated explainer video as well as a CLI version. Also, lnav does the same thing in a TUI and is more capable.
